thread:
mina: hey folks, mina here — joining platform today. Need help getting project redwood-apac-pipeline (id redwood-apac-pipe-9) ready: (1) link to APAC billing account, (2) CPU quota in asia-southeast1 (~32 vCPUs for batch evals), (3) KMS decrypt access for SA pipeline-run@redwood-apac-pipe-9.iam.gserviceaccount.com, (4) permission to create Cloud NAT and reserve 1 static IP, and (5) AWS cross-account assume role arn:aws:iam::888777666555:role/RWD-CI-Assume for deploys. Who do I tag? :wave:

ops-bot: Ticket created: ONB-10021. Please include exact billing id and full KMS resource path. Cloud team hours 08:00-18:00 PT.

harry: welcome @mina! I can take quotas + NAT. For CPUs confirm machine family (n2/n1) and whether you need sustained vCPUs. Also file the quota form and CC me so I can chase. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas

mina: n2-standard family, bursty runs mostly, need 32 vCPUs to start. PD IOPS low for now. KMS key path: projects/redwood-apac-pipe-9/locations/asia-southeast1/keyRings/pipeline/cryptoKeys/artifact-key.

harry: noted. I'll open quota request (expect 1-3 business days) and request a NAT exception for non-prod. If urgent, fallback to us-central1 for short runs.

rachel: billing here 4b0. APAC billing id = 08K9L0-APAC004 (RWD-APAC-BILL). Reply "link apac pipe" and include export dataset name and I'll attach it.

mina: link apac pipe. Export to dev_billing_apac_pipe. Also added the AWS role ARN to ONB-10021.

samir: I'll own KMS and AWS trust. For KMS we'll bind roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to pipeline-run SA. For AWS cross-account, please add the CI principal ARN that will assume the role and I'll add external-id and update trust policy. You can add details to ONB-10021.

mina: CI principal arn:arn:aws:sts::111222333444:assumed-role/ci-agent. Added to ticket. Thanks!

deploy-bot: Temporary dev role created: roles/redwood.dev/temp/mina (expires in 5d). Use gcloud auth login --impersonate-service-account=pipeline-run@redwood-apac-pipe-9.iam.gserviceaccount.com

harry: quota request submitted for 32 vCPUs in asia-southeast1 and NAT/static IP exception opened. I'll update ONB-10021 when approved.

samir: KMS binding queued. For audit, command we will run:

```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding artifact-key \
  --location=asia-southeast1 --keyring=pipeline \
  --member="serviceAccount:pipeline-run@redwood-apac-pipe-9.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
```

Also configuring AWS trust with external-id "apac-pipe-mina". CI will assume with:

```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::888777666555:role/RWD-CI-Assume --role-session-name ci-mina --external-id apac-pipe-mina
```

ops-bot: ONB-10021 updated: billing link requested, quota & NAT exception submitted, KMS binding queued, AWS trust in progress. Assignees: harry (cloud-ops), rachel (billing), samir (security). Expected next update in ~8 hours.

mina: amazing, thanks everyone! I'll wait for updates and try a dry run in us-central1 in the meantime. :rocket:
